about: The secreta of the formulary “2nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the offering to be dedicated to Your name, Lord, purify us and day by day lead us to a heavenly way of life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: may lead to a heavenly way of life
who lives and reigns with You
